title: A Field That Moves With the Vehicle: Protective Fields Sized by Stopping Distance, Bent Round the Turn, and Switched in Sets

questions.question: How long is a protective field?
options: As long as the vehicle needs to stop at its speed, plus a margin
A fixed length, the same at every speed
As long as the scanner can see
Twice the vehicle's length
questions.explanation: The vehicle travels at its speed for the latency, then brakes. The field has to reach at least that far, with a margin on top.

questions.question: A vehicle that stopped when something entered its field stopped:
options: At the thing, with no room
0.20 m short of it, the margin
0.25 m past it
1.5 m short of it
questions.explanation: The field is the stopping distance plus the margin, so when it is right the margin is what remains.

questions.question: With the latency left out of the field, the vehicle stopped:
options: 0.20 m short, as before
0.45 m short
0.25 m past where the thing was
Exactly at the thing
questions.explanation: A latency of 0.3 s at 1.5 m/s is 0.45 m the field did not allow for. The margin of 0.20 m covered some of it and the rest was a collision.

questions.question: At 1.1 m/s, the field of the set designed for 1.5 m/s was how many times as long as needed?
options: 1.00: sets are made for every speed
questions.explanation: A device holds a few sets. At 1.1 m/s the smallest set that is safe is the one for 1.5 m/s, and its field is longer than 1.1 m/s needs.

questions.question: Why does the field bend in a turn?
options: The scanner is mounted off centre
The vehicle sweeps an arc, and a straight field misses a thing on it
Its range is shorter to the sides
The margin is larger on the inside of a turn
questions.explanation: Something on the arc and to one side of straight ahead was outside the straight field and inside the swept one.

questions.question: What does a vehicle do at a speed for which the device has no field set?
options: It uses the largest set it has
It works a field out for that speed on the spot
It carries on with a warning
It has to be slowed to one it has a set for
questions.explanation: At 2.1 m/s with sets up to 2.0 every field is too short. The only safe thing is to come down to a speed that has one.
